records.text: Therysil is Therylune's sister, and her sister's safety clearly matters to her: she reacts with alarm to Therylune's wandering into the unwholesome Master's Glaive, then warmly thanks the messenger on hearing she is safe.

Delgren belongs to an order that works with the night-elf Sentinels against undead and demonic threats. Though initially unaccustomed to night-elf customs, he has grown to respect the Sentinels as allies. He investigates the Dark Strand's soul gems, learned Orcish to understand his enemies, and directs efforts to free trapped Highborne souls and stop Athrikus Narassin.
Ilkrud Magthrull declares for the Dark Strand and threatens his opponents in battle. He can cast Shadow Bolt, Summon Succubus and Ilkrud's Guardians.

Raene Wolfrunner leads the Sentinel effort in Ashenvale from Astranaar, where she directs aid against the furbolg threat. A longtime friend, Teronis, disappeared while seeking a gem for a rod he hoped would slow the attacks. After learning of his death, she sends Sentinels to recover his body and urges his work to continue; she later honors his mission alongside the defense of her people.

Sentinel Selarin serves as Raene Wolfrunner's envoy, recruiting help for the Sentinel effort in Ashenvale. She directs travelers toward Raene in Astranaar, then reports that the Sentinels need aid against corruption. After arranging help, Selarin says she will remain at her post and return if more assistance is needed.
Ran Bloodtooth is a power-hungry satyr whom the quest account condemns as evil and says corruption has made stronger. In combat he uses ranged attacks and may flee for aid.
Bolyun trains hunters to teach their pets and says he only helps hunters and their pets.
A Wrathtail Myrmidon is a combatant that uses Strike.
A Wrathtail Razortail is a combatant that uses Thorns when attacked and Pierce Armor at close range.
A Wrathtail Wave Rider is a combatant that may flee for help when badly wounded.
A Wrathtail Sea Witch is a combatant that uses Lightning Blast.
A Wrathtail Sorceress uses Frostbolt and Frost Nova in combat. When badly hurt, she may flee to seek help.
A Mystlash Hydra inhabits the coast and attacks with a venomous spit.
A Dark Strand Cultist serves among the cultists and can summon an imp even while out of combat; in battle, the cultist casts a spell.
A Dark Strand Enforcer fights for the cult and enters a frenzy when badly wounded.
A Dark Strand Adept serves among the cultists and can summon a voidwalker outside combat.
A Dark Strand Excavator is armed for combat, where it casts a spell.
A Forsaken Seeker uses Holy Smite in combat.
Forsaken Herbalist is found in Ashenvale. In combat, this herbalist casts Contagion of Rot.
Forsaken Thug is found in Ashenvale. It uses Backhand at close range.
Apothecary Falthis is a named elite apothecary in Ashenvale. He casts Shadow Bolt in combat and can cast Summon Voidwalker while out of combat.
Darkslayer Mordenthal is a named figure in Ashenvale.
Saltspittle Puddlejumper is found in Ashenvale. It begins in Battle Stance and casts Rushing Charge when it gains a target.
Saltspittle Warrior is found in Ashenvale. In combat, this warrior casts Defensive Stance.

A Saltspittle Muckdweller is a hostile aquatic humanoid encountered in the waters of Ashenvale. It hurls objects at opponents in combat, a practical ranged attack rather than evidence of any personal history or broader allegiance.

A Saltspittle Oracle is an aquatic humanoid found in Ashenvale. It uses a shock spell against an opponent in combat, marking it as a spellcasting member of the Saltspittle group; no individual beliefs or story are established.

A Foulweald Warrior is a hostile furbolg fighter in Ashenvale. Raene Wolfrunner’s account identifies Foulweald furbolgs as attackers on travelers, and her task names warriors among the targets. This warrior carries a corrupting strength effect and attacks intruders.

A Foulweald Pathfinder is a hostile furbolg encountered in Ashenvale. Its name marks a scouting role, while its passive corrupted agility supports quick movement. The supplied evidence establishes no individual relationships or personal motives.

A Foulweald Den Watcher is a hostile furbolg stationed among the Foulweald camps in Ashenvale. Raene Wolfrunner identifies Den Watchers as threats to travelers, and this watcher uses a defensive thrashing attack when fighting. Its name suggests guarding a den, without identifying any particular den or duty beyond that role.

A Foulweald Shaman is a hostile furbolg spell user encountered in Ashenvale. It lays a Strength of Earth totem while out of combat, and its other recorded abilities include corrupted intellect and fleeing for assistance when badly hurt. These behaviors suggest a support role among the Foulweald, but reveal no personal beliefs or history.

A Foulweald Ursa is a hostile furbolg fighter in Ashenvale and one of the kinds Raene Wolfrunner identifies as attacking travelers. It carries a corrupted strength effect and uses combat attacks; no individual identity or motive is established.
Foulweald Totemics are counted among the Foulweald furbolgs troubling Ashenvale’s roads and camps. This totemic fights with a Searing Totem when combat begins.
A Xavian Rogue encountered in Ashenvale. It is an armed combatant.
A Xavian Betrayer found among the Xavian in Ashenvale. When engaged, it uses Battle Shout.
A Xavian Felsworn found in Ashenvale.
A Xavian Hellcaller encountered in Ashenvale. It casts Gift of the Xavian while out of combat, showing that its spellwork is not limited to a fight.
A Felmusk Satyr found in Ashenvale. It attacks nearby targets with Overwhelming Stench and flees for assistance when badly hurt.
A Felmusk rogue encountered in Ashenvale. It attacks with Overwhelming Stench and Exploit Weakness, and may flee for assistance when badly hurt.
A Felmusk felsworn found in Ashenvale. In combat, it casts Curse of Weakness against its opponent.
A Felmusk shadowstalker that uses Sneak in Ashenvale.
A Bleakheart satyr of Ashenvale. When badly wounded, it may flee to call for assistance.
A Bleakheart trickster encountered in Ashenvale. It attacks nearby foes with Poison.
A Bleakheart shadowstalker found in Ashenvale. When badly wounded, it may flee for assistance.
A Bleakheart hellcaller encountered in Ashenvale.
A lesser felguard found in the northern Kalimdor region of Ashenvale. It casts Fire Shield II in combat and Knockdown when a target is within 0–5 yards.
Akkrilus is a powerful demon in Ashenvale. He uses Immolate and Fire Shield II in combat.
Felslayer is a demon encountered in Ashenvale. It uses Mana Burn against nearby targets.
The Shadethicket Moss Eater is found in Ashenvale. Its combat behavior includes using Moss Covered Hands.
The Shadethicket Wood Shaper is encountered in Ashenvale. It casts Entangling Roots on targets within 30 yards.
The Shadethicket Stone Mover is found in Ashenvale. Its combat behavior includes Strength of Stone.
Shadethicket Raincallers are hostile combatants known for ranged storm magic. This one casts Lightning Cloud at nearby targets and Lightning Bolt at targets within greater range.
A Shadethicket Bark Ripper is a hostile combatant that uses Tendon Rip in combat.
A Terrowulf Fleshripper is a hostile combatant that uses Tendon Rip in combat.
A Terrowulf Shadow Weaver is a hostile combatant casting Veil of Shadow at nearby targets.

The Terrowulf Packlord is a formidable hostile combatant whose tactics include Battle Roar and Intimidating Growl in combat. Its title and exceptional standing mark it out among the local Terrowulves.
A Cenarion Protector is a local protector that can cast Bear Form while out of combat.
Severed Sleepers are undead creatures whose combat behavior includes casting Sleep.
Severed Dreamers are undead creatures that can cast Summon Illusionary Nightmare in combat.
Severed Keepers are undead creatures that cast Mana Burn when an enemy comes within close range.
Forsaken Intruders are humanoid combatants who use Sneak and strike nearby enemies with Backstab.
Forsaken Infiltrators are humanoid combatants whose behavior includes using Sneak.
Forsaken Assassins are humanoid combatants who use Sneak.
A Forsaken Dark Stalker is a humanoid found in Ashenvale. It uses Throw in combat.
An Ashenvale bear ranges across several regions, including Ashenvale. It casts a combat spell when fighting.
An elder Ashenvale bear is found in Ashenvale. When badly injured, it casts Growl of Fortitude.
A giant Ashenvale bear is found in Ashenvale. When badly injured, it casts Growl of Fortitude.
A Clattering Crawler is a beast found in Ashenvale.
A Spined Crawler is a beast found in Ashenvale.
A Blink Dragon is a dragon found in Ashenvale. When injured, it casts a spell.
A Wild Buck is a beast found across several Ashenvale areas. It charges when drawn into combat.
A Shadowhorn stag found across several parts of Ashenvale, this creature charges when threatened. Its native behavior is limited to combat.
An older, more powerful Shadowhorn stag than its common counterpart, the Elder Shadowhorn Stag roams Ashenvale and charges when threatened.
A Wildthorn stalker that prowls Ashenvale. It can cast a web at nearby targets, reflecting its predatory combat role.
A Wildthorn venomspitter found in Ashenvale. It attacks nearby targets with Venom Spit.
A Wildthorn lurker of Ashenvale, this creature hides when it resets and is more powerful than the Wildthorn Stalker.
A Ghostpaw runner found across Ashenvale, it flees for help when badly hurt.
A Ghostpaw howler found in Ashenvale, this creature uses Blood Howl in combat.
A Cenarion Vindicator is a Cenarion defender encountered in Ashenvale. It can cast Moonfire in combat.

Shindrell Swiftfire is a sentinel in Astranaar who considers the town’s southern position exposed as Horde forces gather nearby. She also directs attention to threats farther afield: naga at the Zoram Strand and pridewing venom that, according to intelligence reaching her, orc assassins may use against the Alliance. She is duty-minded but uneasy about ordering the pridewings killed, and regards the naga conflict as bound up with a painful shared history.

A survivor of a naga attack near the submerged ruins of Zoram, Talen lost a prized statuette in his escape and is determined to uncover its secrets. He believes the Ring of Zoram will open its lock and asks for help recovering it from the naga leader Ruuzel.

Orendil Broadleaf seeks Bathran’s Hair to prepare a cure for a sick child whose illness he believes may affect the spirit. Learning that Forsaken are at Bathran’s Haunt troubles him; after preparing the remedy, he asks that it be taken to the child’s parent in Astranaar.

At Forest Song, Kayneth investigates the Forsaken’s disease and its threat to Ashenvale. He personally endured its mind-attacking effects and resisted them; a vision led him to seek peace for the maddened druids killed and poisoned at Dor'danil. He also studies the Chalice of Elune for a possible power to help the wounded forest, fearing corruption will advance if left unchecked.

Sentinel Melyria Frostshadow was sent to Ashenvale to continue Velinde Starsong’s work after Velinde disappeared. Melyria admits she knows nothing of Velinde’s disappearance and refers the question to Sentinel commander Thyn'tel Bladeweaver. She directs investigation of the wolf-men at the Howling Vale, hoping the mysterious Tome of Mel'Thandris will explain their presence; she describes the tome as recording important events in a way few understand.

Sentinel Velene Starstrike is investigating the corruption of Silverwind Refuge’s water elementals. She uses a divining scroll and elemental bracers to identify their controller, then directs the effort against the undead mage Sarilus Foulborne, whom she blames for the corruption. The threat sickens her, and she is determined to make him pay.
A beast named Korra in Ashenvale.

Relara Whitemoon is a sick young girl cared for by her father. While delirious, she asks for him and food. After drinking a cure brought to her, she can wake from delirium, speak of feeling better and ask to go outside and play.

Pelturas Whitemoon is a night elf father focused on treating his seriously ill daughter, Relara. He follows remedies Orendil recommends, hoping each will ease her sickness and restore her strength, and tends to her himself. His dialogue shows his relief and gratitude when she wakes after a cure.

Krolg is an uncorrupted furbolg who blames the night elves for his people's corruption and his exile, though he says furbolgs remain responsible for their own actions. He believes Ran Bloodtooth has become a dangerous evil and wants his own people to stop him before he harms the forest's creatures. Krolg welcomes the company of another uncorrupted furbolg and hopes their tribes may meet again in less violent times.

Illiyana worries about her sisters’ search for the Branch of Cenarius, led by Anilia, when they fail to return from Xavian. She cherishes running and playing with Anilia in the forest. News of Anilia’s death brings disbelief and a plea for vengeance against the satyrs who took her away.
Dagri is Raene’s pet.

Shael’dryn knows Dartol’s Rod and helps Raene’s allies recover and reconstruct it. She recognizes its design as druidic rather than a product of Dartol’s arcane knowledge, and knows a shrine that can recharge it. She admits she does not know where the druids of Dor’danil hid its final piece and dislikes dwelling on their deaths. She also amuses herself with a pun about its druidic nature.

Befouled Water Elementals are hostile beings at Mystral Lake whose attacks have halted transport between Ashenvale and Stonetalon. They strike at nearby travelers and defend themselves with frostbolts.
Withered Ancients are hostile creatures found in Ashenvale. They curse nearby intruders with thorn magic.

Anilia is a wounded dryad who led her sisters’ search for the Branch of Cenarius in Xavian. As she dies, she points north and identifies Geltharis as the one who took it; her appeal sets the branch’s return to Illiyana as the task her rescuers must carry forward.
Thistlefur Ursa are combatants in the Ashenvale area. They enter battle stance, strike nearby foes with heroic attacks, and may flee for help when badly wounded.
Thistlefur Totemics are combatants in the Ashenvale area who cast a healing ward during battle to aid their side.
Thistlefur Den Watchers are combatants found in the Ashenvale area. They can cast Coat of Thistlefur.
A Thistlefur furbolg shaman in the village east of Zoram Strand, this combatant uses Bloodlust in battle. The Horde’s campaign against the village includes it among the targets.
A Thistlefur furbolg avenger, it can cast Coat of Thistlefur and erupt into rage when a friend falls. The Horde’s campaign against the village lists it as a target.
A Thistlefur furbolg pathfinder encountered in the village, it fights with a ranged weapon, using Shoot in combat.
A Shadethicket Oracle is an oracle of the Shadethicket, found in Ashenvale.
A Bloodtooth guard in Ashenvale, it becomes enraged in battle. Krolg’s account identifies Ran Bloodtooth as a powerful wrongdoer and assigns the guards as targets.

Taneel Darkwood is one of the once-great druids of Dor'danil Barrow Den. Poisoned and murdered by the undead, he now wanders as an errant ghost, severed from his body and driven mad. His combat abilities include Shadow Word: Pain and Renew.

Uthil Mooncall is one of the once-great druids of Dor'danil Barrow Den. Poisoned and murdered by the undead, he now wanders as an errant ghost, severed from his body and driven mad. In combat he uses Maul and Moonfire.

Mavoris Cloudsbreak is one of the once-great druids of Dor'danil Barrow Den. Poisoned and murdered by the undead, he now wanders as an errant ghost, severed from his body and driven mad. In combat he uses Lightning Cloud and Chain Lightning.

Ruuzel is the leader of the naga who found the Ring of Zoram. She dwells on an isle at the northern edge of Zoram, where Talen sends an adventurer to retrieve the ring. She attacks with Battle Stance and Heroic Strike.
A Wrathtail naga priestess found among the naga of Zoram Strand, she uses Sleep against opponents in combat.
Bhaldaran Ravenshade is a bowyer who offers goods to browse.
Aeolynn is a clothier in the settlement at area 415. Her shop offers goods for visitors to browse, with a separate option for repair service.
Tandaan Lightmane sells leather armor in the settlement at area 415. His shop offers goods for visitors to browse, with a separate option for repair service.
Dalria is a trade-goods merchant in the settlement at area 415. Visitors can browse her goods; her records also identify her as a quest giver.
Shandrina is a trade-goods merchant in the settlement at area 420. Visitors can browse her goods; her records also identify her as a quest giver.
Harklan Moongrove supplies alchemy goods in the settlement at area 420. Visitors can browse his stock, and he is identified as a quest giver. If threatened and badly hurt, he flees to seek help.
Lardan sells leatherworking supplies in the settlement at area 415. Visitors can browse his stock; he is identified as a quest giver.
Nantar is a baker whose goods can be browsed. His title points to a food trade, setting him apart from the nearby butcher and general-goods merchants.
Ulthaan is a butcher whose goods can be browsed. His trade centers on meat, distinct from Nantar's baking and Maliynn's food-and-drink service.
Maliynn is a food-and-drink vendor, offering provisions distinct from the baker Nantar and butcher Ulthaan. Her recorded combat behavior is to flee for assistance when badly hurt.
Haljan Oakheart deals in general goods, a broader trade than the nearby specialists in baking, butchery, or food and drink. His combat behavior is to flee for assistance when badly hurt.

Danlaar Nightstride trains hunters in the ways and traditions of his ancestors. His training services include instruction and talent specialization, grounding his role in both hunting practice and its inherited traditions.

Kylanna is an alchemy trainer who greets visitors seeking knowledge. In one recorded response, she directs novices toward Milla Fairancora in Darnassus when they need a trainer closer to their skill level.
Cylania Rootstalker is an herbalism trainer.

Aayndia Floralwind trains leatherworking and regards forest protection as a responsibility owed for the gifts Elune gave the night elves. She blames the Horde for bringing demonic taint to the forests.
Fahran Silentblade is a Tools & Supplies merchant whose goods can be browsed.
Llana is a Reagent Supplies merchant whose goods can be browsed.
Dal Bloodclaw is a named combatant who becomes enraged, uses Drain Life and calls for help as his health falls.

Faldreas Goeth'Shael directs a traveler south through Talondeep Path toward Windshear Crag, then onward to Keeper Albagorm at Stonetalon Peak. He says forest spirits have told him the traveler is brave and willing to journey, and warns that the road will be perilous.
The Laughing Sisters are dryads gathered near Raynewood Retreat in Ashenvale. A robe-making request asks adventurers to collect their hair.

Sentinel Thenysil is concerned when Kaela Shadowspear is overdue from investigating trouble in Stonetalon, especially with a gnome mage accompanying her. Thenysil asks for news and is relieved to learn that Kaela and Gaxim are alive and working to stop the Venture Co. and heal the land.
Daelyshia is a sentinel hippogryph master in Astranaar who offers fast travel. When threatened, she calls on the Sentinels for help and summons an enraged hippogryph.
Keeper Ordanus is a Keeper encountered in Ashenvale who fights with Entangling Roots and Lightning Bolt.
Caelyb is a pet trainer who offers hunters training for their pets and the option to untrain them. Caelyb limits this help to hunters and their pets, and addresses a prospective trainee as a friend.

Feero Ironhand is carrying messages and supplies to Sentinel Starbreeze in Auberdine at Delgren the Purifier’s request. Wary of dangerous foes and losing the information to them, he asks for guards before setting out through Ashenvale. On the road he warns of cult assassins and undead, senses an evil presence, and worries that more enemies may be after him. At one point he says he should be fine on his own from there.
Anilia’s dying account identifies Geltharis as the one who took the Branch of Cenarius; her stated wish is for the Branch to be returned to dryad hands.
Phantim is an elite dragonkin whose combat repertoire includes Corrosive Acid Breath.
Burkrum is a heavy armor merchant in the area around Astranaar. He offers armor for sale to travelers.

Searing Infernals are Burning Legion demons found around Felfire Hill and the Demon Fall sites. Vindicator Vedaar identifies them among the Legion remnants he wants destroyed; this infernal's recorded behavior is to maintain a Fire Shield outside combat.
Astranaar Sentinels serve as guards in the areas around Astranaar. This sentinel is stationed in the town's surrounding area.

Roaming Felguards are Burning Legion demons found around Felfire Hill and the Demon Fall sites. Vindicator Vedaar names them among the Legion remnants he wants destroyed; this felguard attacks nearby foes with Knockdown.
Jayla is Astranaar's skinning trainer. She can train the profession, and also offers training services for talents and pet skills.
Harlown Darkweave sells leatherworking supplies in Astranaar. Travelers can browse his goods.
Innkeeper Kimlya offers lodging and goods, inviting weary travelers to rest beneath the inn's roof and let Elune guide their dreams.
Ashenvale sentinels serve as guards.
Alenndaar Lapidaar teaches hunters through ancestral ways and traditions.
Maluressian stables pets and assists with recovering lost companions.
Lady Vespia's combat magic includes Frostbolt Volley and Aqua Jet.
Rorgish Jowl is a humanoid found in Ashenvale.
Oakpaw is a formidable combatant with a notably restorative tactic: when its health falls below half, it can cast Rejuvenation.
Branch Snapper relies on close combat, using Deadly Poison and Knock Away against nearby foes.
Eck'alom fights with elemental magic, casting Frost Shock and Freeze in combat.
Mugglefin's combat style includes spreading Volatile Infection.
Mist Howler attacks with Rend and can unleash a Terrifying Howl in combat.
Prince Raze is a fire and arcane combatant, wielding Fireball, Charged Arcane Bolt, and Fire Nova. When gravely wounded, he may flee for assistance and cast Gift of the Xavian.
Xai'ander is an Ashenvale weaponsmith whose visitors can browse his goods. When badly hurt, he flees for assistance.
Liladris Moonriver awaits Kerlonian Evershade at Maestra's Post. She expresses happiness at the prospect of his arrival and wryly expects him to fall asleep somewhere nearby again.
A Warsong peon, identified by its worker's title and quick to flee for help when attacked.
A Horde scout with a blunt threat for its foes: “Time to die.” It backs the warning with ranged fire, using Shoot in combat.
A Horde tree cutter in the Warsong lumber operation, counted among Overseer Gorthak's minions. It uses Sunder Armor at close range.
A Warsong grunt that fights with Shield Bash in combat and uses Cleave against foes at close range.
A Warsong shaman among the Warsong forces, this humanoid casts Lightning Bolt once combat begins.
A Warsong shredder tied to the Warsong Lumber Camp, this combatant uses Overdrive. Sentinel Luciel Starwhisper names shredders among the camp's targets.
A Mannoroc Lasher is one of the Burning Legion remnants targeted by Vindicator Vedaar's campaign; it fights with Immolate.
Lilyn Darkriver is a named individual found in Ashenvale.
Loruk Foreststrider is a named individual found in Ashenvale.
Feran Strongwind is a named individual found in Ashenvale.

Sentinel Onaeya is a sentinel at Maestra’s Post who receives news about Sentinel Aynasha’s mission. She asks whether Aynasha has returned and expresses relief when told she survived, thanking the visitor and wishing Elune’s protection.

Locke Okarr works with the Warsong lumber camp and is trying to recover supplies needed there. He explains that the shipments of blades, axes, oil, and rope have been scattered or intercepted, and asks for help; once the supplies are brought back, he says the effort has saved him work and thanks the helper.
Fahrak is a named individual found in Ashenvale.
Andruk is a wind rider master who offers flight travel options. He also shouts a warning to the guards and can summon an enraged wyvern when attacked.
Ursol'lok is a powerful named beast whose combat behavior includes mauling an opponent.
Innkeeper Kaylisk is associated with an inn in Ashenvale. The inn welcomes battle-weary travelers to rest and share stories by the fire, with lodging and goods available.
An Emeraldon Boughguard is an elite creature found in the Emeraldon areas of Ashenvale. Its combat routine includes Mortal Strike and Fixate.
An Emeraldon Tree Warder is an elite creature found in the Emeraldon areas of Ashenvale that uses Faerie Fire in combat.
An Emeraldon Oracle is an elite creature found in the Emeraldon areas of Ashenvale. It can use Rejuvenation on a friendly target when that ally is badly hurt.
A Dreamstalker is an elite creature found in Ashenvale. Its combat routine includes Corrosive Acid Breath and Sleep.
Vhulgra is the Wind Rider Master in Ashenvale. Her flight menu asks travelers to choose a destination, and she also has a brief “Guards!” line when calling for help.
Sharptalon is a mighty hippogryph hunted as part of the Ashenvale Hunt. Its claw is sought as a trophy to show Senani Thunderheart at Splintertree Post.

Senani Thunderheart leads the Ashenvale Hunt at Splintertree Post, inviting hunters to test themselves against Ursangous, Shadumbra and Sharptalon and bring back proof. She praises proven hunters, recounts how the beasts threatened Horde workers and travelers, and frames the hunt as a way to learn about oneself and honor the Horde and one's ancestors.

Muglash leads the effort to stop Vorsha after the hydra repeatedly attacks Zoram'gar. He asks for allies, directs the assault on the naga brazier, and intends to face Vorsha himself. Afterward he says he will patrol longer to make sure the area is safe and asks that success be reported to the Warsong Runner.

Gurda Ragescar is a Warsong lumber worker returning to duty at the Warsong Lumber Camp with a shredder she collected in Ratchet. Wind scattered the operating manual's pages on her trip, leaving her unable to use the machine. She admits reading is not her strength and is eager to resume work once the pages are recovered.

At the Zoram Strand, Marukai warns that naga have returned to the ruins of Zoram, though their purpose is unknown. He insists the land claimed by his people must be defended and sends travelers to drive the naga back. He welcomes those who help protect the coast.
Framnali is a named individual found in Ashenvale.

At Zoram'gar Outpost, Mitsuwa mourns her siblings, killed by Thistlefur furbolgs while carrying sacred troll charms. She is outraged that the furbolgs possess the charms, which she says remain valuable in this world, and asks travelers to recover them. Their loss leaves her grieving and furious.
Vera Nightshade is a named individual found in Ashenvale.
Har'alen is a humanoid questgiver.

Pixel is a traveling trader passing through Splintertree Post on her way to Ratchet. She looks for profitable opportunities, including satyr horns that she says are in demand in Ratchet. She also handles a Warsong saw blade shipment and seeks a blunderbuss for protection on her travels.

Je'neu Sancrea is an Earthen Ring member at Zoram'gar Outpost who studies elemental corruption and power. He investigates the naga's harvesting of Aku'Mai sapphires, whose elemental power could become a dangerous arcane component, and seeks evidence about corrupted elementals and Twilight's Hammer activity. He regards the Old Gods as forces of chaos and destruction and asks for Lorgus Jett to be stopped, explaining that he is too weak to do it himself. He says the elements share knowledge and secrets that must be learned and kept.

Mastok Wrilehiss is an orc at Splintertree Post who handles information about caravans and merchants, though he says he dislikes people and wants dealings kept brief. He treats the befouled water at Mystral Lake first as a danger to the transports between Ashenvale and Stonetalon, and he sends help to investigate both the elementals and a possible Alliance observation point. When a globe from the lake reaches him, he recognizes that the Earthen Ring may be better suited to explain it and redirects the investigation to Je'neu Sancrea. He is practical about the threat and sees a chance to gather information on the Alliance as well as protect Horde travel.

Karang Amakkar is a Horde campaign organizer at Zoram'gar Outpost who treats the Thistlefur furbolgs as both an obstacle to Horde movement and a threat to expansion in Ashenvale. He directs attacks intended to open a route between Horde bases while avoiding Alliance entanglements, and celebrates the resulting opportunity for Horde conquest. He also targets the Foulweald tribe, judging its ferocity a future danger and demanding a show of force against its chief. His instructions call for allies, and he frames these operations as part of the Horde's broader campaign to claim Ashenvale.
Tideress is an elemental whose behavior is combat-focused.

Ruul Snowhoof says the Thistlefurs mistook him for a bear, captured him, and starved him until his strength was failing. He asks for help escaping and directs the rescuer to his sister Yama at Splintertree Post. After being freed, he says he needs to rest.
The Wandering Protector is a giant who also serves as a questgiver.

Yama Snowhoof is searching for her brother Ruul, who walked into the forest and has not returned. She regards many furbolgs as noble but considers the Thistlefurs corrupt, and is concerned about how they treated Ruul.
Ashenvale Outrunners are scouts from Silverwing Outpost who move near Horde territory; Kuray'bin suspects them of gathering intelligence on its defenses. They fight with ranged attacks.

Torek leads his raiders against Silverwing Outpost, targeting its leader, Duriel Moonfire. He calls the attack glorious and urges his force to stay calm and avoid giving away their position. After claiming the outpost, he remains there and sends a report of the success to Ertog Ragetusk at Splintertree.
A Splintertree Raider in Torek's attack force, following him during the assault on Silverwing Outpost.
A Warsong Scout reports that the force has held off night-elf attacks and that its plans are going well. The update is for Kadrak at Splintertree.
A Warsong Runner who has witnessed many naga attacks and welcomes the end of Vorsha's freedom. The runner handles local reports and expresses the Warsong force's gratitude for the outcome.
A Warsong Outrider who carries a field update to Kadrak and asks for it to be delivered swiftly.

Kuray'bin at Splintertree Outpost wants the Ashenvale outrunners near his territory stopped before they can gather intelligence on the Horde's defenses. He sends the player to kill them and return; their loss would leave the Alliance less informed and less able to launch attacks.

Ertog Ragetusk receives the report on Torek's assault against Silverwing Outpost and its leader, Duriel Moonfire. He welcomes news of the successful attack, praises the raiders' night elf opponents as strong and fierce, and hopes the player came away with a scar or two.
A guard of Splintertree.
Kil'Hiwana is a fishing trainer in Ashenvale.
Wik'Tar is a fish merchant and supplies vendor who lets visitors browse his goods. His role centers on practical provisions for people in the area.

Sentinel Farsong directs Silverwing's effort against the Warsong Lumber Camp from Silverwing Grove. Farsong receives Sentinel Luciel's report with concern that the Horde's advances bring greater destruction, and says Silverwing cannot retreat while its ancestral lands are at stake. Farsong frames the fight as a defense of land and honor and appeals for others to join.

Illiyana Moonblaze is the Silverwing Supply Officer at Silverwing Grove. She provides care packages containing rations and bandages for use inside Warsong Gulch, and explains that further supplies become available as a fighter proves themself and Silverwing standing grows. Her work equips Silverwing's fighters for the conflict in the Gulch.
Ysondre is a dragon who calls the Dreamers to claim vengeance. She says the strands of Life have been severed and demands that the Dreamers be avenged.
Gapp Jinglepocket serves Smokywood Pastures and offers goods for browsing as a vendor.
Qeeju is a stable master who helps travelers stable their pets and recover lost companions.
Elder Riversong speaks of the stars of this time as beacons of hope and strength for ages to come, and can direct visitors to other elders.

Advisor Sunsworn serves at Splintertree Post and has been expecting a visitor sent by an ambassador. Sunsworn says the ambassador wants them to help strengthen ties within the Horde, and points them toward others who need help.
Vindicator Palanaar identifies himself as a traveling paladin of the Light who has come to assist the night elves.

Sentinel Luciel Starwhisper is a Silverwing Sentinel at Forest Song who opposes the Warsong lumber operation and its destruction of the woods. Luciel vows to resist Overseer Gorthak and wants the camp replaced by a glade of trees. Luciel also has a report for Sentinel Farsong at Silverwing Grove.

Architect Nemos is a draenei architect working with the kaldorei to rebuild the old Forest Song outpost in eastern Ashenvale. The project faces enemies and needs help; Nemos welcomes newcomers and hopes the camp will grow into a lasting settlement.

Gorgannon is a dreadlord and one of the Burning Legion leaders targeted to stop an attack in Ashenvale. His combat behavior includes calling for help, casting Shadow Bolt at range, and using Knockdown nearby.

Vindicator Vedaar is a draenei of the Hand of Argus helping establish a home at Forest Song. Having fled the Burning Legion repeatedly, he is determined to stop its remnant from threatening the settlement again. He warns of an attack planned against Forest Song and is deeply grateful to those who help defend it.

Overseer Gorthak leads logging at the Warsong Lumber Camp. Sentinel Luciel Starwhisper says he orders the orcs to keep cutting even as surplus timber is left to rot, worsening the damage to the forest. Gorthak is a target in the effort to stop the camp's destruction of the land.

Gnarl is an Ancient of War who welcomes the draenei at Forest Song and hopes to help them build a home. He reveres the grove's ancient trees and will not order them felled, instead reclaiming timber from the Warsong loggers and satyrs and purifying it for construction. He also gives seeds to restore demon-corrupted Felfire Hill, though the seedlings will take many years to mature.

Valusha is a determined defender of Splintertree Post, where she opposes the Burning Legion’s threat to the Horde. When she learns of a planned attack, she vows it will not happen and crushes the demon-scrawled plans. She calls for the dreadlords’ deaths and celebrates the Legion’s defeat, recalling its enslavement of orcs and rejecting any return to that subjugation. She also praises strong opponents while disparaging the Alliance.
The Artificer is a humanoid whose greeting is brisk and occupied: they tell a young visitor they are very busy and ask to be excused.
Apprentice Boulian is identified as an apprentice architect, a humanoid whose title marks a junior role in architecture.
Phaedra is a weapon merchant at Forest Song who offers visitors a courteous, open-ended welcome and invites them to ask if she can help.
The Draenei Quartermaster is identified by a draenei affiliation and quartermaster role.
Su'ura Swiftarrow is a Warsong Gulch battlemaster who urges recruits to join the fight, describing it as an opportunity for honor and to earn the Silverwing Sentinels' favor.
Hutihu is Su'ura Swiftarrow's pet, a beast associated with the Warsong Gulch battlemaster.
Suralais Farwind is a hippogryph master offering fast travel. Under attack, Suralais calls for guards, and an enraged hippogryph is summoned.
Auhula is an apprentice hippogryph master. When attacked, Auhula calls for guards, and an enraged hippogryph is summoned.
Aleanna Edune greets visitors warmly, saying it is a pleasure to make their acquaintance. When near defeat, Aleanna flees for assistance.
Becanna Edune flees for assistance when badly injured.
Sulan Dunadaire is a humanoid who flees for help when badly wounded.
William Dunadaire is a humanoid in Ashenvale.
Elenna Edune keeps the animal Goodie as a pet in Ashenvale.
Benjari Edune is a humanoid in Ashenvale.
Goodie is Elenna Edune’s pet, an animal kept in Ashenvale.
A Twilight’s Hammer firesworn in Ashenvale who rejects interference and fights with Fire Shield and Fireball.
The Twilight Flameguard bears the Twilight's Hammer affiliation and threatens its enemies with the crushing force of the elements.

The Ashenvale Flame Warden speaks for the Alliance festival tradition: it welcomes visitors to honor the local flame, honor Alliance fires across the lands, and desecrate Horde fires it calls unworthy.
The Ashenvale Flame Keeper speaks for the Horde festival tradition: it welcomes visitors to honor the local flame, honor Horde fires across the lands, and desecrate Alliance fires it calls unworthy.
Twilight Speaker Viktor bears the Twilight's Hammer affiliation and declares that its vision will be realized, presenting himself as a committed voice for the group's cause.

Ice Caller Briatha is a Twilight's Hammer ritualist coordinating with Neptulon's forces. Briatha describes a Coilfang ritual to bring Ahune through, foresees a world-rending clash between the Firelord and Frostlord, and asks whether the Frost Lord will have a path to the portal.

The Heretic Emissary reports that Skar'this has informed the group and that they have infiltrated the slave pens, where they await the cryomancers. The emissary expects the Tidehunter to welcome this progress as the Firelord's hold weakens.
Heretic Bodyguard is identified by a protective role, but no individual relationships, motives, or views are established.
